title: 一只圓筒罐送進專利局

data.prompt: Medium shot in a 1960s packaging office, one generic designer slides a blank application folder into a plain document tray, focused face visible above the tray, soft window light

lines.text: 一九六六年七月，寶僑在美國申請一項零食包裝專利：

data.prompt: Close-up at a packing bench, one generic packer lowers a neat stack of curved snack slices into a plain rigid cylinder, attentive face above the cylinder, mild overhead light

lines.text: 讓容易碎的薄片整齊疊起來，裝進硬的圓筒。

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a kitchen table, one generic shopper studies a curved snack slice beside an unmarked cylinder, puzzled expression, overcast window light

lines.text: 但罐裡那片零食，幾十年後，會遇上一個包裝解決不了的問題。

data.prompt: Wide shot in a simple British tribunal room, one generic clerk places a closed case folder on a plain hearing table, attentive face, diffuse window light

lines.text: 二〇〇七年，英國稅務法庭要判它算不算應課稅的洋芋片類零食。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a high-ceiling legal reading room, one generic legal reader holds an open blank case folder, thoughtful face turned toward the pages, soft side-window light

lines.text: 隔年，高等法院換了讀法；

data.prompt: Close-up at an appellate court document counter, one generic clerk arranges three closed plain case folders in one row, serious face above the folders, mild ceiling light

lines.text: 到了二〇〇九年，三名上訴法院法官，又得把前兩回合放在一起看。

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a simple study desk, one generic reader holds a plain snack cylinder beside a closed case folder, curious expression, soft table-lamp light

lines.text: 品客為什麼要爭自己不是洋芋片？打完這三回合，最後是誰贏了？

2007 法庭預告回收第一回合與稅率結果。
2008 換讀法回收高院解釋與暫時勝訴。
2009 三回合問題在末章第一段回答。
